## Review checklist (3 minutes)

- [ ] CI is green.
- [ ] The PR touches only the files the task lists.
- [ ] The task's checkbox is ticked and section 1 of `docs/ROADMAP.md` matches.
- [ ] The validation output is pasted and says what the task asked for.
- [ ] If the task has a demo command, I ran it and saw what the task says I should see.
- [ ] Tests were not weakened (the diff does not delete assertions).
- [ ] Merge. If anything fails, comment on the PR and do not merge.
